description: Allowlisted exceptions for audit rules. Keyed by rule slug; values are substrings matched against finding.file or finding.message. test-files: ported from legacy tools/audit-cli/test-audit-exceptions.json at cutover (P6.2). doc-links: (1) `.etc/powershell/.env` and `.claude/settings.local.json` are gitignored by design, so every reference to them is correct yet never resolves in a clean checkout such as CI; (2) `docs/ai/plans/tools-review-and-standardisation.md` is the ledger of the 2026-09 tools/ renames and cites the pre-rename paths on purpose; (3) `docs/ai/plans/new-surfaces-orchestration.md` (status: complete) and the P6.2 completion row of `docs/ai/plans/audit-cli-rebuild.md` record the tree as it stood when that work was done (rewriting any of these would falsify the record); (4) `artifacts/` is gitignored by design (review evidence emitted by tooling), so links from the temporal plans to `artifacts/reviews/...` are correct yet never resolve in a clean checkout; the entry matches the quoted link target, not the file; (5) `docs/ai/plans/temporal-00-program.fable-council-transcript.md` is a verbatim council transcript whose quoted spec names read as bare paths — rewording it would falsify the record. A new broken reference in any other file still fails the gate.
